answer: Sybil resistance by identity-hold deposits. Registration locks a deposit for a fixed multi-epoch hold; only long-held stake earns voting weight. Every clone must copy the pulse in full - cost grows linearly per identity, capital frozen for the whole term. The public deposit ledger shows any farm as one dense comet of same-age deposits from one funding root, visible before it votes. The hold outlasts attack timelines: honest peers compound past the farm's frozen timber before deposits return.
